name: HDDA Iterator Reorganization
definition: A reorganization of Hierarchical Data-Driven Approach (HDDA) iterators to separate traversal of all active values from traversal of only leaf voxels, enabling tile-skipping for leaf-specific operations.
summary: HDDA Iterator Reorganization separates active value and leaf voxel traversal to enable tile-skipping, fixing mis-indexing bugs by providing a specialized leaf-only path.
